plantdoc.bootstrap_method: Image-paired percentile bootstrap, stratified within observed true classes; each replicate preserves class supports and draws the same image indices for every model.
plantdoc.mcnemar_method: Exact two-sided McNemar binomial test on discordant paired correctness outcomes; Holm adjustment across the six exploratory pairwise accuracy tests.
plantdoc.interpretation: Descriptive comparisons on one small external sample. Bootstrap intervals and tests do not address dataset selection, mapping uncertainty, or generalization to a target population.

plantseg_v7.bootstrap_method: Image-paired percentile bootstrap, stratified within observed true classes; each replicate preserves class supports and draws the same image indices for every model.
plantseg_v7.mcnemar_method: Exact two-sided McNemar binomial test on discordant paired correctness outcomes; Holm adjustment across the six exploratory pairwise accuracy tests.
plantseg_v7.interpretation: Descriptive comparisons on one small external sample. Bootstrap intervals and tests do not address dataset selection, mapping uncertainty, or generalization to a target population.

limitations: PlantDoc n=83 across nine mapped classes; PlantSeg n=143 across seven mapped classes, with potato early blight n=9.
External samples are web-sourced curated subsets, not probability samples of farms.
PlantSeg's observed images include mixed plant organs and visual graphics; no causal subgroup inference is made.
Maximum softmax scores are not calibrated uncertainty.
No new model training or robustness intervention was performed; external test results were kept as evaluation evidence.
